artifact_observations.reasoning: The text markings on the hull (intended to be 'FDNY' or similar identifiers) are distorted and illegible. The characters appear melted or fused together, lacking sharp edges typical of painted ship lettering.

The water streams lack coherent fluid dynamics; they appear as solid, opaque white shapes rather than transparent, particulate spray. The connection points of the cannons to the deck are slightly ambiguous and lack mechanical detail.

The railings on the upper decks show slight inconsistencies in thickness and perspective alignment. Some vertical stanchions seem to merge into the background or the roofline without clear mounting points.
